blocks.text: Mission houses sold: price bands, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

In Mission, the sales at $1,800,000 or less were 302 of 305 houses (99%), 65 of 65 townhomes (100%) and 36 of 36 condos (100%), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. The table shows how many sold in each price band.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A count under 5 is shown as "Fewer than 5".

blocks.text: 305 houses sold in Mission with a median price of $905,000 (the middle half sold between $780,000 and $1,095,000), taking a median of 35 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $377 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median lot of 7,060 square feet.

65 townhomes sold in Mission with a median price of $679,900 (the middle half sold between $635,000 and $709,900), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 98.6% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $444 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $349 a month.

36 condos sold in Mission with a median price of $468,250 (the middle half sold between $400,000 and $519,750), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $496 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median strata fee of $433 a month.

These are closed-sale prices, so they show what Mission homes actually sold for, not what they were listed at. A Mission house listed today at $1,800,000 or less can be measured against them: the middle half of the 305 houses sold between $780,000 and $1,095,000, and half of them sold in 35 days or fewer.

faq.q: What did houses in Mission sell for?
faq.a: 305 houses sold in Mission between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $905,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Mission?
faq.a: The median was 35 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Mission sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 305 houses that sold in Mission went for between $780,000 and $1,095,000, around a median of $905,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Mission sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 305 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.0% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Mission?
faq.a: The median year built was 1991 for the 305 houses sold in Mission.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Mission usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Mission had 4 bedrooms, from the 305 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Mission communities sold the most houses?
faq.a: By number sold: Mission BC (252), Hatzic (27), Lake Errock (11), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
